instruction: Show me how to turn on minimal view mode in VLC via the interface options.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view setting). The evaluator uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric which reads the VLC config file and checks if qt-minimal-view=1. Default value is 0 (disabled), so the user must navigate to interface settings and enable it.

Metric function correctly reads qt-minimal-view setting from config file with proper default value of '0'

Expected value '1' is semantically correct for enabling minimal view mode
